research_question: Can the incremental return forecast from external information, after subtracting the forecast explained by V3 stock features, provide a stable bounded Rank1 weight adjustment?

model.core_model: expanding past-only standardized ridge on four compressed V3 stock and benchmark features
model.full_model: same core features plus global-index residuals, official policy, SW L1 sector and compact macro features

carrier.shadow_fill_constraint: candidate actual buy symbols are a subset of V3 shadow buys by signal day and rank

selection.one_standard_error_rule: among tuning-and-validation qualifiers within one standard error of best validation monthly delta choose the smallest lambda
selection.standout_gate: at_least_10_percent relative return improvement or one fewer negative month with drawdown improvement
